events.title: Cozy Airways: An Airline With the Stress Taken Out
events.summary: Cozy Airways is an airline you grow at whatever speed suits you. You open routes across a storybook world, you look after passengers who each turn up with a story of their own and you build a lounge that's worth waiting in. There's no bankruptcy timer and no failure screen. Nothing is chasing you. One little plane, and as long as you'd like to take. The demo is your first month of it, and it's up now for Steam Next Fest, October 19 to 26.If it lands for you, we're on Discord all week: discord.gg

events.title: Cozy Airways: July Devlog
events.summary: July was a big one. We took Cozy Airways apart and put it back together, and almost every screen you have seen before looks different now. A cozier cockpit The old interface felt like a spreadsheet simulator, so we stripped a lot of it out and softened the colors. Sky sits on a little cloud above the dock now and tells you what actually matters, which means no more notification spam. A tutorial that makes sense Completely redone.
